newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia unfreezes $10.6 mln worth of Minfin bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia unfreezes $10.6 mln worth of Minfin bonds.

text.p: Russian police have unfrozen a total $10.6 million worth of Finance Ministry (MinFin) bonds, an official at Vneshtorgbank official, the main depositary for MinFins, said on Tuesday.
"The bonds unfrozen last week were nominally worth $10.5 million," Vneshtorgbank's Deputy head of depositary Andrei Remnyov said.
He said one additional bond nominally worth $100,000 had been frozen by mistake and was cleared earlier.
Police in the Samara region had frozen the paper in May, alleging they had been stolen and resold on the market.
Last year, police froze around $74 million in MinFins but later released about $57 million worth.
Russia's MinFin market is nominally worth $11 billion.
